bagiya.title: Bagiya
bagiya.desc: Child looks at a set of fun creatures in a 'garden' and later tries to remember where each one was placed.

lottery.title: Lottery Ka Ticket
lottery.desc: Child listens to a series of numbers and repeats them in the same order.

mela.title: Chalo Mela Chalen
mela.desc: Child plans a path through simple visual mazes.

rachna.title: Rachna
rachna.desc: Child builds shapes and patterns using pieces.

dhyan.title: Dhyan Kahan Hai
dhyan.desc: Child responds only when they hear specific target words.

herpher.title: Her Pher
herpher.desc: Child keeps rules or information in mind while answering.

numeracy.title: Ankganit
numeracy.desc: Age-appropriate tasks on counting and mathematics.

literacy.title: Padh ke batao
literacy.desc: Tasks around letters and early language readiness.
